references.text: The Lord promises to drive out the nations little by little before the Israelites, the same promise repeated in Joshua 23:5.
God promises to drive out several nations from the land, including the same peoples mentioned in Joshua's context.
Moses predicts that the Lord will drive out the seven nations living in Canaan, the same promise Joshua reminds the people of.
The Lord promises to drive out the nations little by little, as referred to in Joshua's farewell speech.
The promise that the Lord will drive out great and mighty nations before Israel, fulfilled during Joshua's time.
The Lord promises to drive out the inhabitants from the hill country Himself, a repetition of the promise in Joshua's farewell speech.
Joshua reminds the people that the Lord has driven out great and mighty peoples for them, a parallel to verse 5.
Confirmation that all the Lord's promises to Israel were fulfilled, including the promise to inherit the land.
